page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8475B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff, focusing resources entirely on CPU-bound processing and network throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio make this instance profile suitable for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk I/O. Appropriate workloads include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
